verdict.rationale: The only measured numbers in the pack are second-hand community references to third-party latency benchmarks: an older ~41ms figure that one user disputes, and a newer ~13ms average. Throughput support is anecdotal, with one user placing it in the same league as Alacritty when cat-ing large files. Ghostty's own docs publish no benchmarks or performance figures. Missing for 10: first-party published benchmarks, documented latency/throughput methodology and numbers, measured throughput figures, consistent independent corroboration.
